concept.title: Instrument cluster display for warning message

keywords.indexterm: idle stop and go (ISG) malfunction indicator

p.uicontrol: Auto Stop is Off. Shift to P or N and start engine manually.

entry.p: The system may require the engine to manually restart when the light on the ISG OFF button will appear and If your vehicle is equipped with AUTO STOP display, warning message comes on continuously.

p.uicontrol: Press brake pedal to deactivate AUTO HOLD

entry.p: The engine will not restart if the gear is moved from N (Neutral) to D (Drive), Manual mode, or R (Reverse) without depressing the brake pedal while the engine is automatically stopped. In this case, the engine will restart when the brake pedal is pressed.

note.p: If any warning message on the instrument cluster continues to blink, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
